synonyms: That Time I Got Reincarnated as an Evil General in a Hack-and-Slash Game: Destroy the Bad Ending
synopsis: A man works in an exploitative company, and his only joy in life is playing the hack-and-slash game "Brave of Kingdom" when he gets home from work. But one day, when playing the game, he sees something strange, and the next thing he knows, he is inside the world of the game, with the familiar adjutant character Selina before him in her familiar uniform. He has transformed into the game's evil general Zeorg, with his muscular build and full beard, along with his doomed destiny to be mowed down by the game's hero, along with the rest of the game's mooks. Using his survival skills in his exploitative workplace, and his knowledge of the game, Zeorg is determined to avoid a bad ending. (Source: Anime News Network, edited)

synopsis: Tachibana Hinata and Jinguji Tsukasa are two young men who have been friends since childhood. After a disaster of a singles mixer, they’re sent flying into another world by a mysterious being–and now Tachibana is a beautiful blonde girl! But…now the two friends can’t stop thinking about how hot the other is. Will they save the world before their lifelong bromance becomes a romance? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Ranked 19th place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

titleNative: やまとは恋のまほろば
synonyms: Yamato is a Splendid Place for Love
synopsis: College student Sanwa Honoka is ridiculed by male students for her plump figure. As her best friend gets the most out of college life, her only solace is the Ancient Tomb Study Group, where she can talk about her favorite things, surrounded by two laid-back male members. However, Honoka considers member Iida as a lover at a certain moment. A poetic psychological depiction of how a girl with low self-esteem finds spiritual support and matures. (Source: Japan Media Arts Festival) Note: - A Jury Selection award winner in the Manga Section of the 23rd Japan Media Arts Festival. - Originally published on LINE Manga until it was cancelled on 2020-10-11. The serialization moved to Bunshun Online and new chapters published starting 2022-06-20.

synopsis: One day, Charlotte Bennett joins Akito Aoyagi's class as a student studying abroad. Everyone in the class is attracted to Charlotte's beautiful appearance and elegant demeanor, but Akito feels like "we belong in different worlds" and stays away. However, Akito's daily life drastically changes when he rescues Charlotte's younger sister, Emma, when she got lost. He finds out that the Bennett sisters live in the apartment next door to his, and since Emma had taken to Akito, the Bennett sisters start coming over to Akito's place every day. The three of them play dominoes, sit around the dinner table, and go out together. As they spend time together, Akito and Charlotte grow closer, in their own clumsy way… (Source: NicoNico Seiga, translated)

synopsis: Homura-sensei is the frail biology teacher in his track-suit and white lab coat. Hasumi-san is a new home economics teacher, returning to her alma mater to be with him. Their social positions may have changed, but their feelings remain the same. The sweet, awkward romance between them continues, in this new series depicting their love story as adults! (Source: Pixiv Comics, translated) Note: Sekaneko started publishing this manga on her blog on September 14, 2021. On September 2022, the manga got licensed by Kadokawa.
